items.title: Can ACV Auctions (ACVA) Justify $10.50 A Share On Sales?
items.summary: ACV Auctions has seen its share price pulled sharply higher by a US$1.9b all cash takeover agreement, which now puts a firm US$10.50 per share marker on the story. With that offer on the table, the live question for investors is whether this price can be squared with what the business is generating in sales today. items.title: Should You Buy Copart Stock On The ACV Deal?
items.summary: Copart (CPRT) has lost more than a third of its value over the past twelve months, while the S&P 500 gained about 17%. At $29.66, the stock sits at roughly 64% of its 52-week high, and the easy read is that a durable auction business has gone on sale. But its growth slowed well before the acquisition it just announced, and dealer volume is a different business from the insurance volume that is falling.
